definitions.core_principle: Charts that look perfect on paper but don't deliver (or vice versa) are usually explained by (1) retrograde planets, (2) Rahu/Ketu links to retrograde planets, (3) the derived-house check from the dasa lord, (4) the 1-5-9 karma test, (5) the sequence of dasas across life.
definitions.retro_weight: Treat a retrograde planet with the same importance as Rahu/Ketu. Ignoring retrogression can flip a reading by 180 degrees.
definitions.retro_nature: A retrograde planet - benefic or malefic, any dignity - acts powerfully, fast and aggressively (like a fighting cock pulled back that lunges harder).
definitions.retro_reversal: Debilitated + retrograde -> exalted result; exalted/own + retrograde -> debilitated result; Jupiter's aspect neutralises retrogression.
definitions.retro_node_rescue: A retrograde planet connected to Rahu/Ketu (conjunction, aspect or star) gives yoga, not dosha.
definitions.functional_nature: Judge benefic/malefic by lordship for the lagna, not natural nature (e.g. Saturn is yogakaraka for Thula and Rishabha).
definitions.dasa_gate: Every rule acts only in the relevant dasa/bhukti; if the dasa never runs in the life window, the combination is dormant.

rules.name: Retrograde yogakaraka Saturn (Thula lagna)
rules.condition: Saturn (lord_4 + lord_5) retrograde, its dasa running

branches_by_age.result: Property litigation, swap of property, debt from property purchase
Property disputes, grief via children, health (chest - 4th, abdomen/gastro - 5th)

rules.health_by_placement: Health issue also falls on the house Saturn occupies (e.g. 8th: hip bone wear; 2nd: eyes). The house occupied is affected more than the house aspected.

branches.then: Respiratory - phlegm in lungs needing IV/nebuliser

rules.name: Same placement, opposite outcomes (Thula lagna Saturn)

branches.then: Relocation, loss of property, friction with mother; health in old age
Large debt in its dasa, business trouble, relocation
Own business success, many employees, commercial property
Exalted result - property, jewellery, settles children

branches.if: Saturn debilitated in 7th, direct, Mars retrograde or in 6/8/12

rules.name: Retrograde 2nd lord in own/exalted sign
rules.example: Rishabha lagna: Mercury (lord_2) own sign in 2nd or exalted in 5th, retrograde, dasa ~27-45

branches.then: Gives a family, then severe family turmoil in Mercury dasa
Struggles; may wind up or bring in a partner
Rises to top positions (supervisor -> GM, VP, director)

branches.if: with Ketu or in Ketu's star (or Rahu/Ketu link)
branches.then: Research excellence up to a lasting PhD/invention

rules.name: Retrograde Venus as 2nd lord (Kanni lagna, own sign in 2nd)

branches.then: Short-tempered, tense spouse; strain possibly to divorce/remarriage
Separation only for good reasons (work abroad, military)

rules.name: 6th lord in 7th
rules.condition: lord_6 placed in 7th, its dasa running
rules.result: Separation (physical or emotional - e.g. separate rooms, separate finances) in >75% of cases.
exceptions: lord_6 retrograde, or Jupiter aspects, or dasa never runs -> no separation
rules.matching_note: Don't reject a match on this alone - check the exceptions first.

rules.name: Lone Jupiter in 7th / malefic for lagna in 7th
rules.result: Classical warning (lone Jupiter brings disrepute; Jupiter is functional malefic for Thula). Overridden if Jupiter is retrograde and in Ketu's star (e.g. Ashwini) - family stays happy.

rules.name: Derived-house check from the dasa lord
rules.method: To judge family in X dasa, take the 2nd from X's sign and check its lord; for children, the 5th from X; etc.
rules.example: Jupiter in Mesha: 2nd lord from Mesha = Venus; Venus debilitated but neecha-bhanga + with exalted Mercury and Ketu -> family good in Jupiter dasa. Venus 6th from Mesha -> lives away from native place, rented/leased home.

rules.name: Nodes with dignified planets
rules.result: Rahu/Ketu with an own-sign, exalted or retrograde planet amplifies that planet - yoga, not dosha.

rules.name: Karma test - houses 1, 5, 9
rules.method: Score lord_1, lord_5, lord_9 as strong / weak (weak = in 6/8/12, retrograde without rescue, debilitated without neecha-bhanga).

rules.name: Dasa sequence audit
rules.method: List every dasa from birth to ~70 with its lord's house and dignity. Count consecutive dasas whose lords sit in 6/8/12 or are debilitated, plus Rahu/Ketu whose sign and star lords are both in dusthana.
rules.result: A long run of such dasas through the 15-50 window = 'born to struggle' chart, even if the chart shows many named yogas (Hamsa, Sasa, Chandra-Mangala, exchange). A yoga dasa arriving only after ~65 gives little usable benefit.

branches.then: Unruly, unpredictable comings and goings; doesn't heed family

rules.name: Communicating difficult charts
rules.result: Never tell a client 'you will never prosper'. For hard charts, give supportive, constructive guidance; stay composed rather than emotional.

engine_output_suggestion.dasa_timeline: Produce a full life dasa timeline with a per-dasa strength score (CX-13) and flag the age window of each yoga/dosha.
engine_output_suggestion.retro_flag: Every retrograde planet should be shown with its reversal result and any node/Jupiter rescue.
